rationale: The stock is in a five-candle decline off the high on fading volume, but it still sits above session VWAP ($8.35) and the 5m 9-EMA ($8.32), so the intraday uptrend from the 7% gap is not yet broken — the unresolved VWAP test is the actual trigger, favoring longs on a hold and shorts on a break, and neither has confirmed. Entering short here means fighting 16x relative volume above VWAP in a name showing strength against a weak tape, while entering long is catching an active fade mid-air. With only $222.85 of daily loss budget left, ATR of ~2% per 5-minute bar, and $15k of existing exposure in this same sector, the risk-reward of an unconfirmed entry does not justify deploying remaining budget.
